## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL — mixed internals with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; confirmation: even sector participation (6/11) and mixed leadership across cyclicals and Tech produce no clear directional bias.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate leads: AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples also positive: MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication lagging: TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND. Technology under pressure: MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed-to-weak: JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND; AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND; CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND; MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND; QCOM (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -9.48%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: limited — only a minor divergence flag with AMZN in CORRECTION (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +7.44%) suggesting short-term pullback inside a longer monthly gain.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak with internal pressure; NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND but MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology: 6/19 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Patchy and underperforming on the week: BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND and WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND drag the group. Sector breadth: Financials: 8/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed/flat with selective strength: JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND but ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -1.51%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 7/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective cyclicals and defensive staples that are above trend (LMT, CVX, MO, PM); reduce exposure to high-multiple Tech names showing broad 1W weakness (INTU, CRM, ADBE). Style: mixed — remain selective and monitor Tech/Financial divergence for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CVX (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND on strong bullish news (+75) — price confirming sentiment; AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND for continued semi cap strength. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND but negative headlines (-50) are a watch risk; ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND on weak preliminary revenue.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (Sector breadth: Industrials: 10/13 positive) and Energy (Sector breadth: Energy: 6/8 positive) for cyclicals continuation. BEARISH: Communication (Sector breadth: Communication: 2/7 positive) and Technology (Technology: 6/19 positive) for potential further consolidation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 600 (resistance test for ABOVE TREND momentum), AAPL 150 (support to watch as BELOW TREND base), JPM 140 (level to signal stabilization or further downside while below trend), CVX 130 (break/hold to confirm sentiment-driven continuation).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CVX (+75): headline on Venezuela license expansion; CVX (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. JPM (+50): positive coverage after earnings/Apple Card acquisition; JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from weak price, monitor for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-50): China/competitive worries headline; NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for distribution. ISRG (-45): Q4 preliminary weakness; ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming price weakness. CCI (-45): PT cut headline; CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment at odds with price, watch for post-news consolidation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Industrials and select cyclicals showing strength — LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%). Key risk: concentrated Tech weakness and conflicting sentiment (NVDA negative headlines vs price ABOVE TREND) — monitor for confirmation before reallocating.
